risks.quote: AI can produce information that appears factual, convincing and intelligent, but is inaccurate and unreliable. This includes the creation of fake references and hallucinations.
AI outputs are derived from the data used to train the AI tool. This means AI tends to output standard answers that replicate the biases and values in the training data.
When you use a AI tool, the information and data you submit could be used to train the AI.
Like many human activities, our use of AI has an environmental impact.

responsibilities.quote: You should always critically evaluate AI outputs, verifying them against reliable information sources.
Any use of AI tools in academic work must be undertaken in a manner which is ethical and transparent.
UON takes an acknowledgment-based approach to use of AI and commits to support staff and students to build their critical AI literacy.
